query: What is the normal passport processing fee?

hits.text: Processing fees: - Normal service: LKR 10,000.00 - Urgent (one-day) service: LKR 20,000.00 The one-day service is only available at the Head Office in Battaramulla. Required documents include the National Identity Card, the previous passport (for renewals), and two recent passport-size photographs that meet the prescribed specifications.

hits.text: Revised fees effective from 1 November 2022: - Registration and issuance of NIC for the first time: LKR 200 - Issuance of an amended copy of NIC: LKR 500 - Issuance of a duplicate of a lost NIC: LKR 1000 - Issuance of a new NIC replacing one with expired validity: LKR 200 - One-day service surcharge (added to the application fee): LKR 2000 - Translation of NIC to English: LKR 2000 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (bank or state institution request): LKR 500 - Certifying particulars in an NIC (personal request): LKR 1000 Applications are accepted at the area Divisional Secretariat office.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

## සිංහල (summary) ජාතික ගොඩනැගිලි පර්යේෂණ සංවිධානය (NBRO) පසුගිය පැය 24 ක වර්ෂාපතනය 75 mm ඉක්මවන විට කහ (මට්ටම 1) භූමි කඩාවැටීම් අනතුරු ඇඟවීම නිකුත් කරයි. නාය යාම් රෝග ලක්ෂණ දකින්නේ නම් වහා ආරක්ෂිත ස්ථානයකට ඉවත් වන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) தேசிய கட்டிட ஆராய்ச்சி ஸ்தாபனம் (NBRO) கடந்த 24 மணி நேரத்தில் மழைப்பொழிவு 75 மிமீ ஐ தாண்டும்போது மஞ்சள் (நிலை 1) நிலச்சரிவு எச்சரிக்கையை வெளியிடுகிறது. கடுமையான நிலச்சரிவு அறிகுறிகள் தென்பட்டால் உடனடியாக பாதுகாப்பான இடத்திற்கு வெளியேறவும்.

hits.text: --- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

The official validated licence is then posted to the registered owner's address by registered post within 7 days. In-person renewal is available at any convenient Divisional Secretariat office. ## සිංහල (summary) මෝටර් රථ ආදායම් බලපත්ර අන්තර්ජාලයෙන් ලබා ගැනීමේ සේවය (eRL) web.erl2.gov.lk හරහා ලබා ගත හැකි ය. වාහන අංකය සහ චැසි අංකයේ අවසන් ඉලක්කම් 6 ඇතුළත් කරන්න. ක්රෙඩිට්/ඩෙබිට් කාඩ්පත් මඟින් පමණක් ගෙවීම් කළ හැකි ය.

hits.text: --- title: Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service source_url: https://web.erl2.gov.lk/ secondary_url: https://www.gov.lk/services/erl/es/erl/view/index.action source_org: Department of Motor Traffic / Provincial Councils, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Vehicle Revenue Licence — Online Service (eRL) ## English The eRL service is the official online portal for vehicle revenue licence renewal in Sri Lanka. The supported vehicle categories include Motor Cars, Motor Cycles, Dual Purpose Vehicles, Land Vehicles, Three Wheelers, and other classes maintained by the Department of Motor Traffic.

How the service works: - First-time users sign up on web.erl2.gov.lk before logging in. - The user enters the vehicle number and the last 6 digits of the chassis number to confirm ownership. - A valid Insurance Certificate is required. A Vehicle Emission Test Certificate is required for vehicle categories where it applies. - The system accepts credit and debit card payments only. After payment confirmation, a temporary printable licence valid for 14 days is sent by email.

query: Which medication should I use for fever in dengue?

hits.text: --- title: Dengue — patient guidance source_url_1: https://www.dengue.health.gov.lk/web/index.php/en/information/instructions-for-patients source_url_2: https://www.epid.gov.lk/storage/post/pdfs/fact_sheet_on_dengue_for_primary_care_doctors.pdf source_org: National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) & Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Dengue — patient guidance ## English Recommended medication for fever and pain: use Paracetamol only, at the dose prescribed by your doctor.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Seek immediate medical attention if any warning signs appear: - persistent vomiting, - severe abdominal pain, - bleeding from the gums, nose, or in stools, - restlessness, lethargy, or cold extremities, - a sudden drop in temperature accompanied by sweating.

--- title: Seasonal influenza — public guidance source_url: https://www.epid.gov.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=171:dengue-update&catid=51:message-for-public&Itemid=487&lang=en source_org: Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka note: Public-health guidance summarised from Epidemiology Unit communications. accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Seasonal influenza — public guidance ## English Influenza is a viral infection. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Home remedies (papaya leaf juice, lime juice, herbal preparations) are not proven cures for dengue and must not replace medical care. ## සිංහල (summary) ඩෙංගු සාථකව උෂ්ණත්වය හා වේදනාව පාලනය සඳහා පාරසිටමෝල් පමණක් භාවිතා කරන්න.

In Sri Lanka antenatal care is delivered in two modalities: - Domiciliary care provided by the area Public Health Midwife (PHM). - Clinic care provided by Medical Officers.

A pregnant woman is expected to have at least 8 antenatal clinic visits with a skilled healthcare provider and 3 or more home visits by the PHM during the pregnancy. In Sri Lanka antenatal care is delivered in two modalities: - Domiciliary care provided by the area Public Health Midwife (PHM). - Clinic care provided by Medical Officers.

query: Do antibiotics treat the flu?

hits.text: --- title: Seasonal influenza — public guidance source_url: https://www.epid.gov.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=171:dengue-update&catid=51:message-for-public&Itemid=487&lang=en source_org: Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka note: Public-health guidance summarised from Epidemiology Unit communications. accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Seasonal influenza — public guidance ## English Influenza is a viral infection. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

General precautions during flu season: - Stay home if you have flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat). - Cover coughs and sneezes with a tissue or the elbow. - Wash hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, especially after coughing, sneezing, or touching shared surfaces. - People in high-risk groups (children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with chronic respiratory or metabolic conditions) should consider the seasonal influenza vaccine, which is available privately.

Do NOT use Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) such as Ibuprofen, Aspirin, Diclofenac Sodium, Mefenamic Acid, or Celecoxib (tablets or syrup) to reduce fever, because these drugs increase the risk of bleeding. Seek immediate medical attention if any warning signs appear: - persistent vomiting, - severe abdominal pain, - bleeding from the gums, nose, or in stools, - restlessness, lethargy, or cold extremities, - a sudden drop in temperature accompanied by sweating.

A child should not be vaccinated when they have a fever above 38 degrees Celsius on the day of the appointment. The vaccination should be rescheduled with the MOH clinic. Mild low-grade fever and soreness at the injection site within 24 to 48 hours are normal post-vaccination reactions. ## සිංහල (summary) ශ්රී ලංකාවේ ජාතික එන්නත් වැඩසටහන (EPI) 1978 දී ආරම්භ කරන ලදී. Seek medical attention if symptoms last longer than 7 days, if breathing becomes difficult, or if a high fever persists beyond 3 days. ## සිංහල (summary) ඉන්ෆ්ලුවෙන්සා (උණ) වෛරස් රෝගයකි; ප්රතිජීවක ඖෂධ එයට ප්රතිකාරයක් නොවේ. රෝග ලක්ෂණ දින 7 කට වඩා පවතී නම් හෝ හුස්ම ගැනීමේ අපහසුතා ඇත්නම් වෛද්ය උපදෙස් ලබාගන්න. ## தமிழ் (summary) இன்ஃப்ளுயன்சா ஒரு வைரஸ் தொற்று; நுண்ணுயிர் எதிர்ப்பிகள் இதற்கு சிகிச்சை அளிக்க மாட்டாது. அறிகுறிகள் 7 நாட்களுக்கு மேல் நீடித்தால் அல்லது சுவாசிக்கக் கடினமாக இருந்தால் மருத்துவ உதவியை நாடவும்.

Iron and folic acid supplementation is provided to nearly all pregnant women in Sri Lanka; a 2016 national survey found that 98 percent of women with a recent live birth had taken iron pills or capsules during pregnancy. ## සිංහල (summary) ගර්භණී සමයේ පළමු වෛද්ය පරීක්ෂාව සති 12 කට පෙර ආරම්භ කිරීම සුදුසු වේ. ශ්රී ලංකාවේ පූර්ව ප්රසව සත්කාරය නිවසේ පෞද්ගලික සෞඛ්ය මාතාව (PHM) මගින් සහ සායන වෛද්යවරයන් මගින් ලබා දේ.

Prevention focuses on eliminating Aedes mosquito breeding sites: empty and scrub water-holding containers at least once a week, cover all stored water, and dispose of discarded tyres, tins, and plastic items that collect rainwater. Home remedies (papaya leaf juice, lime juice, herbal preparations) are not proven cures for dengue and must not replace medical care. ## සිංහල (summary) ඩෙංගු සාථකව උෂ්ණත්වය හා වේදනාව පාලනය සඳහා පාරසිටමෝල් පමණක් භාවිතා කරන්න.

hits.text: --- title: Seasonal influenza — public guidance source_url: https://www.epid.gov.lk/web/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=171:dengue-update&catid=51:message-for-public&Itemid=487&lang=en source_org: Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka note: Public-health guidance summarised from Epidemiology Unit communications. accessed: 2026-05-27 language: en/si/ta --- # Seasonal influenza — public guidance ## English Influenza is a viral infection. Antibiotics do not treat influenza. Misuse of antibiotics for viral illnesses contributes to antimicrobial resistance, a public-health concern that the Ministry of Health has highlighted in successive advisories.

General precautions during flu season: - Stay home if you have flu-like symptoms (fever, cough, sore throat). - Cover coughs and sneezes with a tissue or the elbow. - Wash hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, especially after coughing, sneezing, or touching shared surfaces. - People in high-risk groups (children under 5, adults over 65, pregnant women, and people with chronic respiratory or metabolic conditions) should consider the seasonal influenza vaccine, which is available privately.

A child should not be vaccinated when they have a fever above 38 degrees Celsius on the day of the appointment. The vaccination should be rescheduled with the MOH clinic. Mild low-grade fever and soreness at the injection site within 24 to 48 hours are normal post-vaccination reactions. ## සිංහල (summary) ශ්රී ලංකාවේ ජාතික එන්නත් වැඩසටහන (EPI) 1978 දී ආරම්භ කරන ලදී. The Call Centre is operating 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with 21 call operators. During floods and other declared disasters, the DMC issues Situation Reports through its public-facing reports portal. Citizens are advised to check the DMC site for the current bulletin before relying on older publications. General flood safety advice issued by DMC and partner agencies: - Do not wade through flowing water deeper than ankle depth on foot.

- Store at least three days of drinking water per family member, and charge mobile phones and power banks once a warning is issued. - Keep important documents in a waterproof container, and pack a small emergency kit (medication, identification copies, torch, first-aid). During the cyclone passage: - Stay indoors. Move to an interior room away from windows.

- The eye of the cyclone passing overhead can create a deceptive calm of about 20 to 30 minutes before high winds resume from the opposite direction. Do not go outside during this calm. query: What are early warning signs of a landslide on the ground?

hits.text: Early warning signs that require immediate action include: - new cracks in walls, floors, or the ground, - doors or windows that suddenly start sticking, - tilted trees or fences, - water seeping from unusual locations on a slope. If severe landslide signs are observed, the public should promptly inform the relevant authorities and evacuate to a safer place to avoid the risks.

- Yellow (Level 1) warning: when rainfall in the previous 24 hours exceeds 75 mm, the public should be aware of the possibility of landslides, slope failures, rock falls, cut-slope failure, and ground subsidence, and should be prepared to evacuate to a safe location if necessary. Special attention should be paid to all hilly areas, to man-made cut-slope roads within the affected districts, and in particular to all landslide-prone sites previously designated by NBRO.
